title: Peruvian Vegan Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Peruvian-inspired rice pilaf, made vegan-friendly with the addition of some key spices and herbs.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the rice and stir to coat with oil and mix with onion and garlic.
Add the pilaf and stir to combine.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in chopped fresh cilantro.
